website.extracted: Apraglutide (GLP-2 analog) for SBS-IF; LINZESS commercial product

ctgov.note: Apraglutide trials sponsored by VectivBio AG (acquired by Ironwood June 2023); supplementary fetch performed.

pipeline.modality: Long-acting synthetic peptide GLP-2 analog, once-weekly subcutaneous
pipeline.license_origin: Acquired via VectivBio acquisition (June 2023); originally GlyPharma Therapeutics

indications.indication: Short bowel syndrome with intestinal failure (SBS-IF) on parenteral support
indications.trial_design: STARS: pivotal Phase 3 of once-weekly SC apraglutide in adult SBS-IF patients dependent on parenteral support; primary endpoint % reduction in PS volume at Week 24 (met). STARS Extend: open-label Phase 3 long-term safety extension. STARS-2: confirmatory Phase 3 with FDA-aligned design; site initiations Q2 2026.
indications.trial_status: STARS COMPLETED (met primary endpoint, 25.5% PS volume reduction vs 12.5% placebo); STARS Extend ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; STARS-2 PLANNED Q2 2026
key_milestones: Feb 2024: Pivotal STARS topline positive on primary endpoint
Q4 2025: FDA alignment on STARS-2 design

commercial_product.name: LINZESS (linaclotide)
commercial_product.indications: Adult IBS-C, adult CIC, pediatric (6-17) functional constipation; pediatric (7+) IBS-C
commercial_product.partners: AbbVie (US + ROW ex-China/Japan); AstraZeneca (China); Astellas (Japan); marketed as CONSTELLA in Canada/EU

excluded_legacy_terminated: IW-3718 (gastric retentive bile acid sequestrant for refractory GERD) — Phase 3 NCT03561090 terminated 2020
MD-7246 IBS-D Phase 2 — completed; not advanced
Apraglutide Phase 2 in acute GVHD (NCT05415410) — terminated
Multiple completed legacy linaclotide Phase 2/3 studies supportive of approved label
excluded_partner_owned: Linaclotide programs commercialized/run by AbbVie, AstraZeneca, Astellas — already approved; not pipeline
